ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the clock to all instantiated submodules. It times sequential logic inside frontend, control, regfile, alu, lsu, pmp, icc and counters instances.
ports.evidence: Connected to clk_i in many port map clauses (frontend, control, regfile, alu, lsu, pmp, icc, counters).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Supplies active-low reset to instantiated submodules so they initialize deterministically. It resets state inside frontend, control, regfile, alu, lsu, pmp, icc and counters per their port maps.
ports.evidence: Connected to rstn_i in port maps for frontend, control, regfile, alu, lsu, pmp, icc, counters.

ports.name: msi_i
ports.functionality: Provides the machine-software-interrupt bit used to form irq_machine. It is combined with mei_i and mti_i to produce irq_machine which feeds control logic.
ports.evidence: Used on RHS of irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i concurrent assignment.

ports.name: mei_i
ports.functionality: Provides the machine-external-interrupt bit used to form irq_machine. It is combined with msi_i and mti_i to produce irq_machine which is routed to control logic.
ports.evidence: Used on RHS of irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i concurrent assignment.

ports.name: mti_i
ports.functionality: Provides the machine-timer-interrupt bit used to form irq_machine. It is combined with msi_i and mei_i into irq_machine which is supplied to control logic.
ports.evidence: Used on RHS of irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i concurrent assignment.

ports.name: firq_i
ports.functionality: Carries fast interrupt bits into the CPU. It is passed directly to the control instance as irq_fast_i to influence control decisions.
ports.evidence: Mapped in control instance port map irq_fast_i => firq_i.

ports.name: dbi_i
ports.functionality: Carries the debug interrupt signal into the control instance as irq_dbg_i so debug/events influence control state.
ports.evidence: Mapped in control instance port map irq_dbg_i => dbi_i.

ports.name: icc_tx_o
ports.functionality: Exports the CPU's inter-core communication transmit interface. When ICC_EN is true it is driven by the icc instance; when disabled it is assigned a terminate constant.
role: driven by icc instance or disabled constant
ports.evidence: Assigned in icc_disabled generate (icc_tx_o <= icc_terminate_c) and port mapped to icc instance when ICC_EN.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.rdy
ports.functionality: Constituent ready bit of the exported icc_tx_o interface. It is driven together with icc_tx_o when ICC is enabled (mapped to icc instance) or by icc_terminate_c when disabled.
ports.evidence: Part of icc_tx_o port; icc_tx_o assigned in icc_disabled or driven by icc instance via port map.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.ack
ports.functionality: Constituent ack bit of icc_tx_o. It is exported from the cpu and driven via the icc instance when ICC_EN or by fallback when disabled.
ports.evidence: Part of icc_tx_o record; driven in icc instance port map or by disabled branch assignment.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.dat
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of the exported icc transmit interface. It is driven by the icc instance when enabled or by the disabled-case constant otherwise.
ports.evidence: Part of icc_tx_o record; seen in icc instance port map and in icc_disabled assignment.

ports.name: icc_rx_i
ports.functionality: Imports the inter-core communication receive interface into the CPU and supplies it to the icc instance when ICC_EN; otherwise it is unused by other logic here.
ports.evidence: Connected in icc instance port map icc_rx_i => icc_rx_i when ICC_EN; icc instance drives xcsr_icc via csr_rdata_o.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.rdy
ports.functionality: Ready bit of the imported icc_rx_i interface. It is provided into the icc instance when ICC is enabled and thereby influences xcsr_icc and icc behavior.
ports.evidence: Part of icc_rx_i record; passed into icc instance via port map.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.ack
ports.functionality: Ack bit of the imported icc_rx_i interface. It is supplied to the icc instance and used there to update icc CSR outputs.
ports.evidence: Part of icc_rx_i record; mapped into icc instance port map.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.dat
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of the imported icc_rx_i interface. It is delivered into the icc instance when ICC_EN and can influence xcsr_icc CSR outputs.
ports.evidence: Part of icc_rx_i record; passed to icc instance via port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o
ports.functionality: Exports instruction-side bus requests to memory/peripherals. It is driven by the frontend instance (mapped in its port map) and presented to the outside world.
ports.evidence: Mapped as ibus_req_o in frontend instance port map (ibus_req_o => ibus_req_o).

ports.name: ibus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: 32-bit address field of the exported instruction bus request. It is part of ibus_req_o driven by frontend and reaches external bus fabric.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o record; frontend instance maps to ibus_req_o.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field in the instruction bus request record; carried outward by ibus_req_o and driven by frontend when needed.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_req_o; present in frontend instance port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: 4-bit byte-enable field of ibus_req_o, exposed on the instruction bus. Driven by frontend via ibus_req_o.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o record; frontend drives ibus_req_o.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Strobe bit of the exported instruction bus request. It is produced by frontend and presented to external bus logic.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o; mapped in frontend instance port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Read/write flag for instruction bus requests, part of ibus_req_o and driven by frontend instance.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_req_o record; passed from frontend via port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Single-bit source field in ibus_req_o record. Driven by frontend to label request origin; exported to bus.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o; present in frontend port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Privilege flag in ibus_req_o provided by frontend instance and exported for bus arbitration/permission checks.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_req_o record; mapped in frontend instance port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Debug flag in the instruction bus request record. Driven by frontend and exported for debug fetches.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o record; connected in frontend port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Atomic operation indicator in ibus request record, supplied by frontend and exported.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o; driven by frontend per port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: 4-bit AMO operation code field in ibus_req_o. Populated by frontend and exported to the bus.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_req_o record; present in frontend instance port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Lock bit in the instruction bus request exported from the CPU, driven by frontend instance.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_req_o; mapped by frontend in port map.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Fence control bit in ibus_req_o driven by frontend and exported to ensure ordering semantics on the bus.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_req_o record; driven by frontend instance per port map.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Imports instruction bus responses into the CPU frontend. The frontend instance receives ibus_rsp_i to produce fetched instructions.
ports.evidence: Mapped in frontend instance port map ibus_rsp_i => ibus_rsp_i.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Ack bit of the instruction bus response record. Passed into the frontend instance and used to drive fetch handshake.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_rsp_i record; mapped into frontend via port map.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Error bit in the instruction bus response. It is provided to the frontend instance to flag fetch faults.
ports.evidence: Field of ibus_rsp_i record; used in frontend port map.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of instruction responses. It is supplied into the frontend instance which produces frontend.instr.
ports.evidence: Part of ibus_rsp_i record; connected in frontend instance port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o
ports.functionality: Exports data-side bus requests. It is driven by the load/store unit (lsu) instance and presented to external memory/peripherals.
ports.evidence: Mapped as dbus_req_o in lsu instance port map (dbus_req_o => dbus_req_o).

ports.name: dbus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: 32-bit address field of the exported data bus request driven by the LSU and sent to external bus.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o record; driven by lsu via port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field for data bus requests. It is provided by the LSU (wdata_i=>rs2) and exported on dbus_req_o.
ports.evidence: Part of dbus_req_o record; mapped by lsu instance port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: 4-bit byte-enable field of dbus_req_o, used for stores/loads. Driven by the LSU and exported.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o; present in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Strobe bit for data bus requests driven by the LSU and exported to signal valid transfers.
ports.evidence: Part of dbus_req_o record; mapped in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Read/write flag for data bus requests. It is provided by the LSU and exported to the bus fabric.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o; driven by lsu instance via port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Source identifier bit in dbus_req_o. Populated by the LSU and exported on dbus requests.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o record; connected in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Privilege flag in dbus_req_o. Supplied by the LSU and exported to control access level of data operations.
ports.evidence: Part of dbus_req_o record; present in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Debug indicator in data bus requests. It is driven by the LSU and exported when debug accesses occur.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o record; mapped in lsu instance port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Atomic operation indicator in dbus_req_o provided by the LSU and exported to memory system for AMO handling.
ports.evidence: Part of dbus_req_o record; present in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: 4-bit AMO opcode field in dbus_req_o. Set by LSU and exported for AMO semantics on the data bus.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o record; driven by lsu in port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Lock bit in data bus requests indicating exclusive/locked accesses. Driven by the LSU and exported.
ports.evidence: Part of dbus_req_o record; mapped in lsu instance port map.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Fence bit in data bus request used to enforce ordering. Driven by LSU and exported.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_req_o record; present in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Imports data bus responses into the LSU. The lsu instance receives dbus_rsp_i to produce rdata, err and ack signals.
ports.evidence: Mapped in lsu instance port map (dbus_rsp_i => dbus_rsp_i).

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Ack bit of the data bus response record. Provided to the LSU to complete transaction handshakes.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_rsp_i record; mapped into lsu via port map.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Error indicator of data bus responses. Passed to the LSU instance where it becomes lsu_err and affects control.
ports.evidence: Part of dbus_rsp_i record; connected in lsu port map.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: 32-bit data field of data bus responses. It is delivered into the LSU which drives lsu_rdata for the register file or CSR writes.
ports.evidence: Field of dbus_rsp_i record; mapped to lsu instance rdata_o => lsu_rdata.

signals.name: xcsr_cnt
signals.functionality: Holds CSR bits produced by the counters unit. It is driven by the counters instance rdata_o when counters are enabled or set to zero when disabled, and combined into xcsr_res.
role: driven by counters instance or zeroed
signals.evidence: Either rdata_o => xcsr_cnt via counters instance port map, or xcsr_cnt <= (others => '0') in cnts_disabled generate; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or ...

signals.name: xcsr_pmp
signals.functionality: Carries CSR bits generated by the PMP unit. It is driven by the pmp instance csr_o and merged into xcsr_res for CSR reads.
role: driven by PMP or zeroed when disabled
signals.evidence: In pmp_enabled, pmp port csr_o => xcsr_pmp; in pmp_disabled xcsr_pmp <= (others => '0'); xcsr_res combines fields.

signals.name: xcsr_alu
signals.functionality: Carries CSR bits produced by the ALU (CFU/FPU/ALU) and is ORed into xcsr_res for CSR reads. Driven by ALU instance csr_o port.
signals.evidence: ALU instance port map csr_o => xcsr_alu; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc.

signals.name: xcsr_res
signals.functionality: Combines CSR contributions (counters, ALU, PMP, ICC) using bitwise OR. The aggregated value is provided to the control unit as xcsr_rdata_i.
signals.evidence: xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc and control instance maps xcsr_rdata_i => xcsr_res.

signals.name: xcsr_icc
signals.functionality: Carries CSR bits produced by the ICC unit. When ICC_EN is true it is driven by the icc instance csr_rdata_o; otherwise it is zeroed. It is ORed into xcsr_res.
signals.evidence: In icc_enabled icc port csr_rdata_o => xcsr_icc; in icc_disabled xcsr_icc <= (others => '0'); combined into xcsr_res.

signals.name: ctrl
signals.function: control bus between frontend and datapath
signals.functionality: Acts as the central control/status bus: driven by the control instance (ctrl_o) and consumed by frontend, regfile, lsu, pmp, alu and counters. It carries control fields like pc_ret and CSR enables.
signals.evidence: ctrl is declared and connected ctrl_o => ctrl in control instance port map; many instances map ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.if_fence
signals.functionality: Field inside ctrl used to signal instruction-fence events to frontend. It is part of the control bus produced by the control instance and consumed by frontend.
signals.evidence: ctrl is produced by control instance and passed to frontend; field referenced as ctrl.if_fence in port definitions.

signals.name: ctrl.if_reset
signals.functionality: Control bit inside ctrl used to request frontend reset. It is driven by control logic and consumed by frontend to reset fetch state or pipeline.
signals.evidence: ctrl is mapped from control instance into frontend; field ctrl.if_reset present in ctrl type.

signals.name: ctrl.if_ack
signals.functionality: Field in ctrl used to handshake acknowledgements with the frontend. It is produced by control logic and read by frontend.
signals.evidence: ctrl mapped into frontend; ctrl.if_ack is a field of ctrl_bus_t.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_cur
signals.functionality: Field of the control bus representing the current PC value. It is produced by control logic and consumed by other units that may reference PC state.
signals.evidence: ctrl structure contains pc_cur; control instance drives ctrl and frontend/regfile see ctrl fields.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_nxt
signals.functionality: Control field that holds the next PC candidate. It is generated by control logic and available on ctrl for consumption by pipeline/frontend.
signals.evidence: pc_nxt is a field of ctrl_bus_t and ctrl is driven by control instance.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_ret
signals.functionality: Control field holding a PC return value used as one source for register-file writeback. It is included in the rf_wdata selection and driven by control logic.
signals.evidence: rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret; ctrl driven by control instance.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_wb_en
signals.functionality: Control bit enabling register-file writeback. Produced by control instance and consumed by regfile to gate writes.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t and control instance drives ctrl; regfile maps ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rs1
signals.functionality: 5-bit register index field produced by control logic and consumed by regfile to select rs1 output.
signals.evidence: ctrl produced by control instance, regfile port rs1_o => rs1 is mapped; ctrl.rf_rs1 is index field in ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rs2
signals.functionality: 5-bit index field for register-file source 2. Generated by control and used by regfile to select rs2 output.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t; regfile instance provides rs2 via rs2 signal; ctrl supplies index.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rd
signals.functionality: 5-bit destination register index used by regfile to select writeback target. Provided by control logic and consumed by regfile.
signals.evidence: ctrl fields include rf_rd; regfile maps ctrl_i => ctrl in port map.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_zero_we
signals.functionality: Control bit that inhibits writes to register x0. It is part of ctrl produced by the control instance and used by regfile to prevent x0 writes.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t; regfile receives ctrl via port map.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_op
signals.functionality: 3-bit ALU operation selector produced by control logic. It is consumed by the ALU instance to select operation behavior.
signals.evidence: ctrl maps into ALU instance (ctrl_i => ctrl) and contains alu_op field.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_sub
signals.functionality: Single-bit control to request subtraction behavior in ALU. Provided in ctrl by control instance and used by ALU.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t; ctrl is port-mapped into ALU instance.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_opa_mux
signals.functionality: Select bit inside ctrl choosing ALU operand A source. Generated by control and used by ALU instance to multiplex input A.
signals.evidence: ctrl contains alu_opa_mux; ctrl routed to ALU instance.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_opb_mux
signals.functionality: Select bit in ctrl selecting ALU operand B source. Produced by control and consumed by ALU to choose operand B.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t; used by ALU instance via ctrl_i mapping.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_unsigned
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating unsigned ALU operations. Generated by control logic and read by the ALU to affect comparisons/operations.
signals.evidence: ctrl field alu_unsigned present; ctrl port-mapped to ALU instance.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_imm
signals.functionality: 32-bit immediate value carried in ctrl for ALU immediate operations. Produced by control and consumed by ALU instance as an operand source.
signals.evidence: Field ctrl.alu_imm inside ctrl_bus_t; ctrl fed to ALU instance.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_alu
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating ALU coprocessor usage. It is provided to ALU/control units via ctrl and read by ALU to select coprocessor path.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t; ctrl mapped into ALU instance.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_cfu
signals.functionality: Control bit to enable CFU coprocessor path inside ALU. Generated by control and consumed by ALU instance.
signals.evidence: ctrl field present in ctrl_bus_t and passed to ALU via port map.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_fpu
signals.functionality: Control bit to select FPU coprocessor path in ALU. Produced by control logic and passed to ALU instance.
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl_bus_t and routed to ALU instance in port map.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_req
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating a load/store request. It is produced by control instance and consumed by the LSU to start memory operations.
signals.evidence: ctrl mapped into LSU (ctrl_i => ctrl); ctrl.lsu_req is a control field.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_rw
signals.functionality: Single-bit control indicating read or write for LSU. Generated by control and used by LSU to set dbus_req_o.rw and internal behavior.
signals.evidence: Field ctrl.lsu_rw in ctrl_bus_t and ctrl passed to LSU instance.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_amo
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating atomic operation for LSU. It is provided by control and consumed by LSU to enable AMO handling and export on dbus_req_o.amo.
signals.evidence: ctrl contains lsu_amo; ctrl passed to LSU in port map.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_mo_we
signals.functionality: Control bit used to enable memory-ordered writes in the LSU. Produced by control logic and consumed by LSU.
signals.evidence: Field of ctrl_bus_t; ctrl port-mapped into LSU.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_fence
signals.functionality: Fence request bit to enforce memory ordering for LSU. Set by control logic and read by LSU instance to manage fences.
signals.evidence: ctrl.lsu_fence is a ctrl field and ctrl is mapped to LSU in port map.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_priv
signals.functionality: Privilege indicator for LSU operations. Produced by control and used by LSU to tag requests (dbus_req_o.priv).
signals.evidence: Part of ctrl_bus_t; ctrl passed to LSU instance via port map.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_we
signals.functionality: Control bit enabling CSR writes. It is driven by control logic and passed to ICC and other CSR consumers to permit writes.
signals.evidence: ctrl.csr_we is mapped into icc instance csr_we_i and ctrl is driven by control instance.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_re
signals.functionality: Control bit requesting CSR read. Produced by control and passed to ICC and CSR sources to read CSR values.
signals.evidence: ctrl.csr_re mapped to icc csr_re_i and ctrl driven by control instance.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_addr
signals.functionality: 12-bit CSR address carried in ctrl. It is produced by control and consumed by ICC/CSR sources to select the CSR register for access.
signals.evidence: ctrl.csr_addr present in ctrl_bus_t; mapped into icc instance port csr_addr_i.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_wdata
signals.functionality: 32-bit write data for CSR operations, produced by control and consumed by ICC/CSR logic when csr_we is asserted.
signals.evidence: Field ctrl.csr_wdata inside ctrl and mapped to icc csr_wdata_i in port map.

signals.name: ctrl.cnt_halt
signals.functionality: 16-bit control mask to halt counters, produced by control logic and provided to counters instance to control counting behaviour.
signals.evidence: ctrl has cnt_halt field; ctrl passed to counters instance via port map when included.

signals.name: ctrl.cnt_event
signals.functionality: 12-bit event selector for performance counters. Provided by control and used by counters instance to select events to count.
signals.evidence: Field ctrl.cnt_event in ctrl_bus_t; ctrl mapped to counters instance.

signals.name: ctrl.ir_funct3
signals.functionality: 3-bit field representing funct3 decoded by control. It is carried in ctrl and used to steer datapath/ALU behavior.
signals.evidence: ctrl contains ir_funct3 field and is passed to ALU and other units via ctrl_i mappings.

signals.name: ctrl.ir_funct12
signals.functionality: 12-bit field with funct12/imm bits carried in ctrl. Produced by control and used by other units for decoding or immediate selection.
signals.evidence: Field ctrl.ir_funct12 exists in ctrl_bus_t and ctrl passed to ALU/control consumers.

signals.name: ctrl.ir_opcode
signals.functionality: 7-bit opcode field carried in ctrl for instruction decode. Generated by control logic and used by datapath units to select behavior.
signals.evidence: ctrl.ir_opcode part of ctrl, used across frontend/ALU; ctrl is port mapped.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_priv
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating current privilege level. Produced by control and carried to other units to tag accesses and decisions.
signals.evidence: ctrl contains cpu_priv field; ctrl port-mapped to frontend and LSU.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_sleep
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating CPU sleep state. Produced by control logic and available to other units for power/idle behavior.
signals.evidence: Field ctrl.cpu_sleep in ctrl_bus_t; ctrl passed to frontend.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_trap
signals.functionality: Control bit that flags a trap condition. Set by control logic and consumed by frontend and other units to handle traps.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpu_trap field exists in ctrl_bus_t and ctrl routed to frontend.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_debug
signals.functionality: Control bit indicating debug mode. Produced by control unit and read by frontend/regfile/others to alter behavior during debug.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpu_debug field and ctrl passed to frontend and regfile via port maps.

signals.name: frontend
signals.functionality: Package of instruction fetch outputs produced by the frontend instance. Driven by the frontend and consumed by the control instance (frontend_i => frontend).
signals.evidence: frontend_o => frontend in frontend instance port map; neorv32_cpu_control_inst maps frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.valid
signals.functionality: Valid bit from frontend indicating a fetched instruction is available. Generated by the frontend and consumed by control logic.
signals.evidence: frontend is produced by frontend instance; control instance maps frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.instr
signals.functionality: 32-bit fetched instruction provided by frontend. It is consumed by control logic for decode and control decisions.
signals.evidence: frontend.instr delivered by frontend instance; control instance receives frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.compr
signals.functionality: Single-bit flag indicating a compressed instruction from frontend. Produced by frontend and used by control logic for decode/pc increment decisions.
signals.evidence: Field of frontend record set by frontend instance and passed to control instance.

signals.name: frontend.fault
signals.functionality: Flag from frontend indicating fetch fault; produced by frontend and provided to control to handle fault/trap responses.
signals.evidence: frontend.fault field set by frontend instance; control instance maps frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.halted
signals.functionality: Bit indicating the frontend is halted. Set by frontend instance and examined by control logic to coordinate debug/halt states.
signals.evidence: frontend.halted provided by frontend instance and mapped into control instance frontend_i.

signals.name: rf_wdata
signals.functionality: Holds the value to be written back to the register file. It is computed combinationally from alu_res, lsu_rdata, csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret and connected to regfile rd_i.
signals.evidence: rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret; regfile port rd_i => rf_wdata.

signals.name: rs1
signals.functionality: 32-bit value output from the regfile for source operand 1. It is driven by regfile instance rs1_o and consumed by ALU and other units (mapped to rs1_i in ALU).
signals.evidence: regfile port rs1_o => rs1 in regfile instance port map; rs1 mapped to ALU rs1_i.

signals.name: rs2
signals.functionality: 32-bit value output from regfile for operand 2. Driven by regfile rs2_o and consumed by ALU and LSU (wdata_i of LSU).
signals.evidence: regfile rs2_o => rs2 in regfile port map; rs2 mapped to ALU and LSU wdata_i => rs2 mapping.

signals.name: rs3
signals.functionality: Optional third register operand driven by the regfile rs3_o port. It is provided to ALU instance rs3_i when enabled by RS3 feature.
signals.evidence: regfile port rs3_o => rs3; ALU port rs3_i => rs3 in ALU port map.

signals.name: alu_res
signals.functionality: 32-bit result produced by the ALU instance and used as one of several sources for register-file writeback (rf_wdata). It is produced by the ALU's res_o port.
signals.evidence: ALU port res_o => alu_res in ALU port map; rf_wdata <= alu_res or ...

signals.name: alu_add
signals.functionality: Addition result produced by the ALU (add_o) used as address input to LSU and also supplied to control/other units. It is driven by the ALU instance and mapped to lsu.addr_i.
signals.evidence: ALU port add_o => alu_add and lsu port map addr_i => alu_add; pmp maps addr_ls_i => alu_add.

signals.name: alu_cmp
signals.functionality: 2-bit compare result produced by the ALU instance (cmp_o). It is provided to the control unit to influence branching/decisions.
signals.evidence: ALU port cmp_o => alu_cmp in ALU port map; control instance maps alu_cmp_i => alu_cmp.

signals.name: lsu_rdata
signals.functionality: Read data returned from LSU (rdata_o) used as a source for register-file writeback (rf_wdata). It is driven by the lsu instance rdata_o.
signals.evidence: LSU port rdata_o => lsu_rdata in lsu instance port map; rf_wdata <= ... or lsu_rdata ...

signals.name: alu_cp_done
signals.functionality: Single-bit done indicator from ALU coprocessor operations (done_o). It is driven by the ALU instance and fed into control logic as an input.
signals.evidence: ALU port done_o => alu_cp_done; mapped into control instance alu_cp_done_i => alu_cp_done.

signals.name: lsu_wait
signals.functionality: Single-bit handshake from LSU indicating it is busy/waiting (wait_o). Driven by the lsu instance and consumed by control logic to stall or sequence events.
signals.evidence: LSU port wait_o => lsu_wait in lsu port map; control instance maps lsu_wait_i => lsu_wait.

signals.name: csr_rdata
signals.functionality: Holds CSR readback data produced by control/CSR sources. It is an input to the register-file writeback selection and is driven by control instance csr_rdata_o.
signals.evidence: control instance port csr_rdata_o => csr_rdata and rf_wdata <= ... or csr_rdata ...

signals.name: lsu_mar
signals.functionality: MAR produced by LSU to report effective memory address. It is driven by the lsu instance mar_o and consumed by control for status/diagnostics.
signals.evidence: LSU port mar_o => lsu_mar in lsu port map; control instance maps lsu_mar_i => lsu_mar.

signals.name: lsu_err
signals.functionality: 4-bit error vector produced by the LSU (err_o). It is driven by the lsu instance and consumed by control logic to handle memory faults.
signals.evidence: LSU port err_o => lsu_err; control instance maps lsu_err_i => lsu_err in its port map.

signals.name: pmp_fault
signals.functionality: Single-bit fault output from the PMP unit indicating access violations. It is produced by the pmp instance and consumed by control logic.
signals.evidence: pmp port fault_o => pmp_fault in pmp port map; control instance maps pmp_fault_i => pmp_fault.

signals.name: irq_machine
signals.functionality: 3-bit IRQ vector formed combinationally from mti_i, mei_i and msi_i. It is provided to control logic to indicate active machine-level interrupts.
signals.evidence: irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i concurrent assignment; mapped to control instance irq_machine_i => irq_machine.
